what: Run records of the published results, as first made on 19 October 2026 in the author's private working repository (raiven-cipher-hunter). The results files in this repository are those files with the machine- and time-dependent fields (code commit, seconds) moved here, and with text that reproduces the edition left out (see README, Licensing). A rerun of code/run_all.sh writes them byte for byte.
machine: Linux, CPU only, nice -n 19, at most 6 processes; Python 3.13.14, numpy 2.5.4

preregistration.note: the file is unchanged since that commit

l3_code.note: written after the pre-registration; run once with 20 controls as a smoke test before the full runs, with no parameter changed after it. l3_q3c.json recorded the pre-registration commit as its code commit: that run finished before the code was committed; the code differed only by lint fixes.
